objects.description: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has stolen valid OAuth credentials from DevOps personnel or a company GitHub repository.(Citation: Intel471_SH_Aug2021) Additionally, [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has stolen application access tokens to access cloud services and to bypass authentication mechanisms.(Citation: SOCRadar_ShinyHunters_Mar2024)
